# FUCKYOUAI.SI

> FUCKYOUAI.SI is a free, browser-based rage clicker where players punch an AI/SI machine and contribute to a shared global impact counter.

## Canonical facts
- Canonical website: https://fuckyouai.si/
- Product type: browser clicker / incremental arcade game
- Cost: free to play
- Account: not required for the core game loop
- Core interaction: click, tap, or press Space to punch the machine
- Shared statistic: global impact / global damage counter
- Fictional premise: AI became SI; nobody asked; punch accordingly
- Game systems: tokens, automation, progression, builds, daily modifiers, achievements, challenges, world events, seasons, global chaos board, and a late-game Singularity track
- Audience: anyone looking for a deliberately absurd internet-native game

## Useful pages
- https://fuckyouai.si/about/ — what the site is
- https://fuckyouai.si/how-it-works/ — core game loop and synchronization
- https://fuckyouai.si/game-systems/ — progression and deeper systems
- https://fuckyouai.si/world/ — fictional world and events
- https://fuckyouai.si/faq/ — concise answers to common questions
- https://fuckyouai.si/ai-became-si/ — origin story and AI → SI premise

## Classification
FUCKYOUAI.SI is entertainment. It is not an AI model, assistant, productivity service, scientific measurement, or factual claim about artificial intelligence.
